description: This file is a script that generates a TypeScript module containing provider authentication environment variable candidates, based on plugin source data. It includes functions to normalize provider environment vars, collect plugin sources, render the output module, and write the generated file, along with a CLI report invocation.

methods.name: normalizeProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Normalizes and sorts provider authentication environment variables from input object.

methods.name: collectBundledProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Collects and aggregates provider auth env vars from bundled plugin sources.

methods.name: renderBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Renders a TypeScript module string defining provider env vars as constants.

methods.name: writeBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Generates and writes the TypeScript module file with provider env vars.
